recentItems.description:
Farmers in Shayampet mandal of Hanamkonda district have raised concerns after the Warangal 44 Siddhi paddy crop failed to reach the grain formation stage even after 150 days. They allege losses due to faulty seeds and demand an official field inspection and compensation. The dealer says the matter will be brought to the company and government’s attention.
